# LoopTroop 0.4.0

LoopTroop 0.4.0 is a major release focused on human-verified delivery, lower runtime overhead, sharper diagnostics, and a much more usable daily workspace.

- 🧪 **Manual QA Verification:** Interactive post-implementation testing gate with evidence uploads, automated QA-fix loops, and direct backlog improvement creation.
- 🎨 **Modernized Dashboard & UI:** New glassmorphic theme, Markdown description previews, and resizable log drawers.
- ⚡ **Native OS File Watching:** Replaced brute-force file polling with native OS file watching across Linux, macOS, and Windows for major CPU savings and snappier refresh cycles.
- 🧠 **10-Member Councils & Routing:** Support for up to 10 council models with live voting tallies and OpenRouter modifiers such as `:nitro`, `:thinking`, and `:free`.
- 🪵 **Smarter Diagnostics & Logs:** Fast log pagination that opens on the newest 20 entries first, standardized AI headers, and live token/cost tracking.
- 🛠️ **Repo & Lifecycle Tools:** New repo attachment modes (Restore, Clear tickets, Start fresh), complete ticket deletion, 50,000-character descriptions, and npm 12 support.
